configure_logging: configure logging with scenario-aware formatting and optional tqdm progress bar compatibility
set_logger_scenario_id: set the scenario ID and optional run number for the current thread logger context
get_logger_scenario_id: get the scenario ID associated with the current thread logger context
TqdmLoggingHandler: create a custom logging handler that writes messages via tqdm to avoid progress bar conflicts
ScenarioAwareFormatter: create a colored log formatter that prepends scenario ID and run number to log messages
